verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs state that https://docs.mercury.com/llms.txt indexes all pages in Markdown and all endpoints in OpenAPI, explicitly for AI agents. A probe confirmed llms.txt is live (HTTP 200), and the ReadMe-based API reference publishes per-endpoint schemas. The 404s on guessed paths like /openapi.json do not contradict the documented location. Missing for 10: a directly verified OpenAPI file URL or download (the probed llms.txt excerpt is truncated before any OpenAPI link), a spec at a conventional well-known path, and independent hands-on confirmation that the spec is complete and downloadable.
